name: Summit AZ - Perf Tracker
body:
> Tracker · Summit Az · 2026-09-24

# Summary
Framework and tooling for proving whether speed and layout work changed anything, built for Summit AZ (GA4 property 529636373, Rank Math as SEO system of record, Search Atlas and OTTO as analysis only) but portable. Also holds the September 2026 client reports.

# Method (from README.md)
- One rule: capture the baseline before every deploy (`psi_batch.py --tag pre-deploy`). The September work had no baseline.
- Lab (Lighthouse) is for debugging and regression gates; field (CrUX, trailing 28-day p75) is for ranking and client reporting. TBT is lab, INP is field. Single Lighthouse runs vary 5 to 10%; trust only deltas over 10 points or medians of three.
- Most Summit local pages hit CrUX origin fallback; report them on lab data only and say so.
- Recommended: send `web-vitals` into GA4 via a Code Snippets entry for per-page field data; register custom dimensions and metric.
- GSC: page-level data is reliable, query-level is about 75% incomplete; Search Atlas GSC mirror undercounts. `gsc_compare.py` diffs two exports with a CTR z-test (under 1.96 is noise). Speed should not change CTR.
- Monitoring layers: weekly PSI API sweep on `urls.txt`, monthly full sweep (`--from-wp`, 201 URLs) and Screaming Frog crawl comparison, plus a regression gate (mobile LCP over 2500 ms or score drop over 10).
- Monthly client dashboard: executive summary, what shipped, technical health, behavior with a control group, search performance, business outcomes, method and caveats. Use difference-in-differences with 10 to 15 page cohorts.

# CHANGELOG.md
Rules for a site change log: write the entry before deploying, one entry per deploy window, record timezone (Arizona UTC-7, no DST), never bundle speed with content or metadata changes, immutable IDs `YYYY-MM-DD-NN`, read field data at deploy plus 28 days. The only entry (2026-09-16-01, drain-cleaning family image compression) is explicitly an example for formatting, not a real result.

# Files in this folder
- `README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`: framework and change log.
- `urls.txt`: stable PSI sample (money pages, one local page, contact, blog).
- `gsc-compare-jun-vs-sep.csv`: site, page and query deltas Jun vs Aug 24 to Sep 22.
- `dashboard.html`, `dashboard-technical-backup.html`, `case-study.html`, `brand\summit-logo.svg`, `shots\` (GA4 landing, GSC performance and experience, PSI homepage screenshots).
- Reports: [Summit AZ - 90-Day Before After 2026-09-23](lib:brain-summit-az-90-day-before-after-2026-09-23), [Summit AZ - Performance Report 2026-09-23](lib:brain-summit-az-performance-report-2026-09-23), [Summit AZ - SEO Progress Report 2026-09-24](lib:brain-summit-az-seo-progress-report-2026-09-24).
- `psi_batch.py`, `gsc_compare.py`: scripts.
